item.title: New Mexico Health Care Authority To Host Public Feedback Session On CARA Transition Wednesday April 1
item.description: NMHCA News: SANTA FE — The New Mexico Health Care Authority will host an online public feedback session Wednesday, April 1, to gather input on the transition of the Comprehensive Addiction and Recovery Act (CARA) program to the agency. The session will take place from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. and will focus on the upcoming transfer of CARA administration to the Health Care Authority, which is scheduled to take effect July 1, 2026. item.description: WILLIAM BRIAN SEDLACEK Oct. 19, 1964 – Feb. 24, 2026 William Brian Sedlacek, affectionately known as Brian, was born on October 19, 1964, in Laramie, Wyoming. item.title: UNM-LA Advisory Board Meeting For March Canceled In Absence Of New Business Items
item.description: UNM-LA News: The UNM-Los Alamos (UNM-LA) Advisory Board is not holding its regularly scheduled board meeting on Monday, March 9, as there are no actionable items requiring discussion at this time. Executive team reports will be posted on the advisory board webpage. The next meeting is scheduled for Monday, April 13.
